body.statement: For every fixed even \(m\ge2\), the explicit law \(P_m^{\mathrm{Par}}\) belongs to \(\mathcal H_{\beta,D}(m)\). Consequently, the fixed-\(m\) Hall class is nonempty and the minimax supremum is not vacuous.
body.justification: The explicit exact-Pareto law certifies coherence of every fixed-cell experiment before minimax analysis begins.
body.gap: This is a model-validity lemma rather than a novelty claim; it rules out vacuity caused by cross-\(m\) quantification.
body.consumer: The regret and confidence-width suprema range over a demonstrably nonempty class for each admissible cell count.
